Today, Joint Base Charleston officially becomes Joint Base Lindsey Graham, a fitting tribute to a man who spent his life fighting for it.

Over the years, Sen. Graham directed hundreds of millions of federal dollars toward the base's mission, including his role in bringing Boeing's Dreamliner production to the area. His fingerprints are on every corner of JBC, from championing its mission to securing the resources it needed to grow.

Joint Base Lindsey Graham now carries his name forward.
